reason: The `dev:cron` script (apps/web/package.json:9-10) runs apps/web/cron-tester.ts, which calls `/calendar-cache/cron` every 5 seconds (cron-tester.ts:26). Switching it to tsx is therefore a fix to the tool developers use to exercise the calendar-cache feature, much like the scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh helper the patch also adds.
